eligibility.rule: Require published simulation inputs, an optimizer-successful history fit with normalised RMSE <= 0.30, both capacity directions identified, and all three issue-anchored forecast points. Absolute simulator/forecast level disagreement is not a hold-back rule.

forecast_path.method: Linear interpolation from the latest reported count through issue-anchored 4/8/12-week blend forecasts; intermediate weeks are not independently fitted forecasts.
forecast_path.uncertainty: Original forecast 80% ranges are interpolated only as separate reference evidence, not combined with the change-sensitivity range.

parameter_uncertainty.method: Linearized circular residual-block bootstrap with bounded weak-direction variation and nonlinear calibration-fit screening
parameter_uncertainty.assumption: Uniform variation along weak directions within original 0.4–1.8 bounds; allow 6 × residual variance × 3 weeks additional calibration SSE.
parameter_uncertainty.caveat: Approximate parameter-sensitivity ensemble, not a confidence region or identified structural uncertainty. Conversion, queue split, age shape and service order remain assumed.

interpretation: The forecast supplies the waiting-list level; paired queue-model differences supply the effect of a change. Conditional planning sensitivity, not a validated causal effect.

assumptions.combined_shocks: Strike and winter capacity multipliers multiply; referral surge affects arrivals. All begin on day28.
assumptions.comparison: No extra capacity uses the same selected pressures. With no pressure or capacity change, the displayed path equals the statistical forecast.
assumptions.formula: displayed = max(0, forecast_point + simulator(plan, pressures) - simulator(no capacity, no pressures)); capacity delta = simulator(plan, pressures) - simulator(no capacity, same pressures)
assumptions.pairing: Capacity parameters, arrival uniforms and service-noise draws are identical across each comparison. Differences are formed per draw before any quantile.
assumptions.ranges: 10th–90th percentiles of the paired change, translated around a fixed central forecast and floored at zero. These conditional sensitivity ranges exclude forecast-level uncertainty and are not combined predictive intervals.
assumptions.forecast_ranges: Original forecast 80% ranges are retained separately in forecast_path for evidence; no independence or correlation assumption combines them with intervention effects.
assumptions.absolute_outputs: The original six-month absolute simulation is retained in decision_support.json for Evidence only.
assumptions.serialization: Full-precision JSON numbers preserve equality with source forecast anchors; paired differences, floor and quantiles are computed before serialization.
